topic: Aviation - white spiral on the jet engine spinner (warns ground crew)
question: WHY IS THE SPIRAL
PAINTED ON?
answer_full: To warn the ground crew that the engine is running
recap: Many jet engines have a white spiral painted on the cone in the middle of the fan.
explain: A running fan turns so fast that its blades almost disappear. And with ear protection on, the ground crew can't always hear which engine is running.
The spiral makes it obvious. When it swirls, the engine is turning, and everyone stays out of the danger zone in front of the intake.
Some say the spiral also scares birds away. But that has never been proven.
